Class clientSocket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.socket.clientSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
Network
public class clientSocket extends Object implements Network
Implementation of the Network interface using Java Socket communication.

This class is responsible for establishing a connection with the server, sending serialized Message objects, and continuously listening for incoming messages from the server on a dedicated thread.

All server communication is performed using ObjectOutputStream and ObjectInputStream.

  • Constructor Details

    • clientSocket

      public clientSocket(String host, int port) throws IOException
      Creates a new client socket and connects to the specified server.

      Initializes input and output streams and starts a background thread to continuously listen for messages from the server.

      Parameters:
      host - the server hostname or IP address
      port - the server port number
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs when creating the socket or streams

    • listenFromServer

      private void listenFromServer()
      Continuously listens for messages coming from the server. Each received message is executed on the client side using the associated ClientController. This method runs on a dedicated thread started at construction time.
